title: Via Control
description: Via Control is a Via Version add-on that allows you to choose what client versions (like 1.20-1.21.11) into your server.
body:
# What is Via Control?

**Via Control** is a powerful enhancement and modern replacement for *VersionControl*, designed as a seamless add-on for ViaVersion.

It gives server owners more precise and flexible control over cross-version player behavior, improving compatibility management beyond what traditional VersionControl offers.

---

## ✨ Features
- Advanced version control built on top of ViaVersion  
- Improved handling of player version restrictions  
- Lightweight and performance-friendly design  
- Drop-in replacement for VersionControl  
- Fully compatible as a ViaVersion add-on  

---

## 🚀 Why Via Control?

Unlike older solutions like VersionControl, Via Control is actively designed for modern Minecraft server ecosystems, giving you cleaner integration, better stability, and more control over how different client versions interact with your server.
